name: Oxyplug Image
author: Oxyplug Team

sections.description:
Oxyplug Image speeds up your website by automatically optimizing your images. It compresses your photos, creates multiple display-ready versions (1X, 2X, 2.8X, and 3X DPRs, including Retina Display quality), and converts them to faster formats like WebP, and (AVIF available in Premium). It also preloads your featured images to improve your Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) and boost your Core Web Vitals score on Google Lighthouse.

Oxyplug Image gives you the flexibility to load images using either the standard tag or the advanced tag for better browser compatibility and performance.

For safety, the plugin automatically saves a backup of your original images, and you can choose how long to keep them (default is 60 days). You can restore any original image at any time during that period. Even if you deactivate or uninstall the plugin, all optimized images remain on your server and continue to work normally.

Key benefits for everyday users:

  • Makes images load much faster without losing quality
  • Creates high-resolution images for Retina screens
  • Automatically generates 1X, 2X, and 2.8X images (3X Premium)
  • Helps your site perform better on Google
  • Fully automatic, no technical skills required
  • Reduces server load and saves bandwidth
  • Supports both and tags for maximum flexibility
  • Bulk image optimization
  • Safe backup system with user-configurable retention period

(Premium) Features:

  • AVIF image format
  • 3X DPR image generation
  • Image and text watermarks
  • Add copyright information
  • More image credits
sections.installation:
Installation from within WordPress

  1. Visit Plugins > Add Plugin.
  2. Search for Oxyplug Image.
  3. Install and activate the Oxyplug Image plugin.

Manual installation

  1. Upload the entire oxyplug-image folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Visit Plugins.
  3. Activate the Oxyplug Image plugin.
